content: {"paper_id":"W7168288936","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"ensemble-clustering","exact_quote":"The clustering ensemble technique that combines multiple clustering results is an effective strategy to improve the accuracy and robustness of the final clustering.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以聚类集成为研究任务，明确融合多个聚类结果以获得更优的最终聚类划分。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"Firstly, we design a second order induced co-association relation (SoCo), which realizes the idea that two samples may be in the same potential unobserved cluster if they have common neighbors that simultaneously belong to multiple clusters.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"提出并构造二阶诱导共协关系(SoCo)，基于共同邻居丰富样本间共协关系矩阵，属于对样本间亲和/关系结构的建模或修正。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
